title: Return the largest k measurements
prompt: Return up to k values in descending order. Keep duplicate values. Do not change the input. If k exceeds the input size, return all values. Tests check results, not performance.
signature: std::vector<int> topK(const std::vector<int>& values, std::size_t k)

tests.label: Keep duplicates
tests.hint: Duplicate measurements occupy separate result slots.

tests.label: Larger than input
tests.hint: Clamp k to the input size.

tests.label: Negative values
tests.hint: Descending order still applies to negative numbers.

hints: Copy the input before rearranging it.
partial_sort can order just the requested prefix; a full sort is also correct but may do more work.
explanation: partial_sort places the largest k values at the front when used with greater<int>. Resizing removes the unused suffix. Tests validate behavior; benchmarking is a separate task.
